title: RadioSonde Track Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radiosonde:track
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sonde_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when RadioSonde track data has stopped arriving for a given sonde.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per sonde and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It combines when one part of your RadioSonde track feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
